title: 국방정보본부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:21915:20091230:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum <Presidential Decree No. 21915, December 30, 2009>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Defense Reform shall be amended as follows:
Article 19 (1) 6 shall be replaced with the following:
6. Commander of the 777 Command.
(2) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 13 (1) 2 (a), "Commander of the Special Intelligence Unit of the Ministry of National Defense" shall be replaced with "Commander of the 777 Command".
In the column of Army positions in attached Table 1, "Commander of Unit 3275" shall be replaced with "Commander of the 777 Command".
Article 3 (Relationship with Other Statutes and Regulations)
Where any other statute or regulation in force at the time this Decree enters into force cites provisions of the former Decree on the Defense Intelligence Headquarters, and this Decree contains corresponding provisions, the citation shall be deemed to be a citation of the corresponding provisions of this Decree in lieu of the former provisions.
